targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(latest.total_repositories), 0) as total
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.total_repositories
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(latest.active_repositories), 0) as active
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.active_repositories
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(latest.unique_contributors), 0) as contributors
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.unique_contributors
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(latest.total_commits), 0) as commits
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.total_commits
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(latest.total_prs_merged), 0) as merged
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.total_prs_merged
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(latest.critical_vulnerabilities), 0) as critical
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.critical_vulnerabilities
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT
  s.name as service,
  latest.total_repositories,
  latest.active_repositories,
  latest.unique_contributors,
  latest.total_commits,
  latest.total_prs_merged,
  latest.critical_vulnerabilities,
  ROUND(latest.avg_test_coverage::numeric, 1) as test_coverage_pct,
  ROUND(latest.avg_pr_review_time_hours::numeric, 1) as avg_pr_review_hrs
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id)
    sm.service_id,
    sm.total_repositories,
    sm.active_repositories,
    sm.unique_contributors,
    sm.total_commits,
    sm.total_prs_merged,
    sm.critical_vulnerabilities,
    sm.avg_test_coverage,
    sm.avg_pr_review_time_hours
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest
JOIN services s ON latest.service_id = s.service_id
ORDER BY s.name;

panels.description: Latest-period snapshot for each service. **Active Repos** — repos with ≥1 commit in the period (red=0, yellow=1–2, green≥3). **Critical Vulns** — critical severity vulnerabilities (green=0, yellow=1–2, red≥3). **Test Coverage** — average across repos (red<50%, yellow 50–79%, green≥80%). **Avg PR Review** — mean open-to-merge time (green<4 h, yellow 4–24 h, red≥24 h).

SELECT
  sm.period_start as time,
  s.name as service,
  sm.total_commits as commits
FROM service_metrics sm
JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(sm.period_start)
ORDER BY time, service;

SELECT
  sm.period_start as time,
  s.name as service,
  sm.total_prs_created as created
FROM service_metrics sm
JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(sm.period_start)
ORDER BY time, service;

SELECT
  sm.period_start as time,
  s.name as service,
  sm.total_prs_merged as merged
FROM service_metrics sm
JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(sm.period_start)
ORDER BY time, service;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(latest.avg_test_coverage)::numeric, 1) as coverage
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.avg_test_coverage
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
    AND sm.avg_test_coverage IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(latest.avg_maintainability_index)::numeric, 1) as maintainability
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.avg_maintainability_index
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
    AND sm.avg_maintainability_index IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(latest.total_quality_issues), 0) as issues
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.total_quality_issues
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(latest.avg_pr_review_time_hours)::numeric, 1) as review_hours
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.avg_pr_review_time_hours
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
    AND sm.avg_pr_review_time_hours IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT
  sm.period_start as time,
  s.name as service,
  sm.avg_test_coverage as coverage
FROM service_metrics sm
JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  AND sm.avg_test_coverage IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(sm.period_start)
ORDER BY time, service;

SELECT
  sm.period_start as time,
  s.name as service,
  sm.avg_maintainability_index as maintainability
FROM service_metrics sm
JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  AND sm.avg_maintainability_index IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(sm.period_start)
ORDER BY time, service;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(latest.critical_vulnerabilities), 0) as critical
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.critical_vulnerabilities
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(latest.high_vulnerabilities), 0) as high
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.high_vulnerabilities
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(latest.eol_dependencies), 0) as eol
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.eol_dependencies
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(latest.total_dependencies), 0) as total
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.service_id) sm.total_dependencies
  FROM service_metrics sm
  JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
  WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  ORDER BY sm.service_id, sm.period_start DESC
) latest;

SELECT
  v.severity,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM vulnerabilities v
JOIN dependencies d ON v.dependency_id = d.id
JOIN repository_services rs ON d.repo_id = rs.repo_id
JOIN services s ON rs.service_id = s.service_id
WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  AND d.analyzed_at = (
    SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM dependencies WHERE repo_id = d.repo_id
  )
GROUP BY v.severity
ORDER BY
  CASE v.severity
    WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1
    WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2
    WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3
    WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END;

SELECT
  sm.period_start as time,
  s.name as service,
  sm.total_vulnerabilities as vulnerabilities
FROM service_metrics sm
JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(sm.period_start)
ORDER BY time, service;

SELECT
  sm.period_start as time,
  s.name as service,
  sm.critical_vulnerabilities as critical
FROM service_metrics sm
JOIN services s ON sm.service_id = s.service_id
WHERE s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(sm.period_start)
ORDER BY time, service;

SELECT
  r.repo_id,
  r.name as repository,
  s.name as service,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commits c WHERE c.repo_id = r.repo_id AND c.commit_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as commits_30d,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) FROM commits c WHERE c.repo_id = r.repo_id AND c.commit_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as contributors_30d,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pull_requests p WHERE p.repo_id = r.repo_id AND p.status = 'open') as open_prs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pull_requests p WHERE p.repo_id = r.repo_id AND p.merged_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as merged_prs_30d,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(v.id) FROM vulnerabilities v JOIN dependencies d ON v.dependency_id = d.id WHERE d.repo_id = r.repo_id AND d.analyzed_at = (SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM dependencies WHERE repo_id = r.repo_id)), 0) as vulnerabilities,
  r.last_analyzed_at
FROM repositories r
JOIN repository_services rs ON r.repo_id = rs.repo_id
JOIN services s ON rs.service_id = s.service_id
WHERE r.is_active = true
  AND s.name IN (${service:singlequote})
ORDER BY commits_30d DESC;
